stocks.name: RedCloud Holdings plc
stocks.why: London-based B2B commerce/AI platform. Repaid all its convertible notes; new Argentina distributor deal. The 1:20 split will shrink the share count sharply, and the CEO is at the ROTH conference days later.
stocks.risk: Down ~98% in a year. At-the-market (ATM) offering and equity lines in place; appealing a Nasdaq delisting decision. Post-split names often get sold into.

stocks.name: Hyperscale Data
stocks.why: AI data centre + bitcoin holder guiding $180–200M revenue for 2026 and targeting a Q4 profit. Very heavy retail volume. Main shareholder (Ault & Co.) bought 10.4M shares at $0.50.
stocks.risk: Persistent ATM stock sales, several preferred share classes; 52-week high $3.65 → serial dilution.

stocks.name: Lucid Diagnostics
stocks.why: Sells EsoGuard, an esophageal pre-cancer test, and keeps winning insurance coverage policies. Analyst targets ~$4.
stocks.risk: Tiny revenue vs. losses; shareholders approved more authorised shares → dilution likely.

stocks.name: Inovio Pharmaceuticals
stocks.why: FDA granted accelerated approval for Voceryq (INO-3107) on 30 10 2026 — first US-approved DNA medicine. Roughly tripled on the news, then cooled. Topped a short-squeeze leaderboard on 03 11.
stocks.risk: The big move has happened. Rare-disease launch against an approved rival; cash runway only into early 2027 → offering risk.

stocks.name: Jasper Therapeutics
stocks.why: 1:30 split effective 06 11 left ~1.1M shares. Briquilimab (good urticaria data); KP-104 interim Phase 2 data due Q4 2026.
stocks.risk: Going-concern warning; an offering after the split is likely.

stocks.name: Accuray
stocks.why: Real business (radiotherapy systems) doing a large split to stay listed. Real-revenue names can re-rate post-split if results stabilise.
stocks.risk: Large splits signal distress; often drifts lower afterwards.

stocks.name: Lakewood-Amedex Bio
stocks.why: Tiny antibiotic-resistance biotech (Nu-3 gel). June split left ~1.75M shares, so volume becomes huge % moves (+228% on 05 11).

stocks.name: 22nd Century Group
stocks.why: 1:58 split on 05 11 → ~551K shares. Ultra-low float.
stocks.risk: Split because the business is failing; dilution usually follows.

stocks.name: CDT Equity
stocks.why: 1:20 split on 05 11 → ~1.0M shares.

stocks.name: Algorhythm Holdings
stocks.why: Pivoted from freight-AI (SemiCab) to renewable power via Azure Energy; marketing a 1,500 MW Mississippi project to co-located tenants (AI data-centre power theme). New CEO since 30 10; strategic review.
stocks.risk: Defaulted on a SemiCab promissory note; heavily dilutive financing history; $3.48 (13 02) → ~$0.10.

stocks.name: The Children's Place
stocks.why: ~44% of a ~7.3M-share float sold short; swinging ±35% a day.
stocks.risk: Losses every quarter, falling sales; below $1 → split/delisting clock.

stocks.name: Mercer International
stocks.why: Real pulp producer (~$1.9B revenue) valued at ~$25M. Spiked +84% in August on Canadian government funding.
stocks.risk: Rated CCC-, noteholder talks, going-concern doubt; a debt-for-equity swap could wipe out shareholders.

stocks.why: Classroom tech launching AI tools; repeated volume explosions on news; losses narrowing.
